preregistered: 2026-08-30, before any Experiment 3 state was scored
limit: 24.0 wall-clock hours or 3 unique network-state evaluations, whichever first

lanes: null-start, ordered by measured A1 singles
policy.quota_split: one third each; unused quota from a terminated lane passes to the seeded-random lane
policy.ordering_bias: neighbours are visited drops-first (worst member first), then adds and swaps in measured-A1-singleton order. Nothing is discarded and every neighbour stays reachable — visit order only.
policy.dedup: one shared checkpoint across all lanes; a state scored in any lane is never re-scored

objective: generalized_cost + lambda * w_unserved * unserved_demand, w_unserved read from config/cost_weights.yaml
caching: exact-state only — the state digest is the permutation-invariant mutation set, so a cache hit means identical geometry and nothing weaker
